diagnosis: G5: L3 is soft. pre-commit never requires an active task at phase >= record; core/history-entry is excluded from hook review legs (HOOK_REVIEW_EXCLUDES) and commit-msg appends the trailer when no history file is staged, so code commits without a task or without a history entry pass silently. Fix in git-eval/git-hook/git-history: task-phase gate on code-class pre-commit scope, staged-history requirement on code/docs commit-msg scope, deps-shaped changes exempt.
